Vendor / hibob pricing

HiBob pricing in 2026

HiBob refuses to publish list rates. Buying-committee evidence puts Core at ~$10 PEPM, with Performance, Compensation, and Surveys each adding $3-$5 PEPM. Full suite at 150-500 seats typically lands $18-$25 PEPM. Minimum seat count is 50 in practice; smaller deployments get routed to BambooHR or Gusto.

What the buying committee actually pays

Strongest culture/surveys story in mid-market. US payroll requires a third-party integration; not native. The ledger applies a default 12% annual renewal uplift unless the buyer caps it in the MSA - our own central modelling assumption, adjustable on the renewal-uplift page, not a vendor-published rate.

Why does HiBob refuse to publish pricing?

HiBob sells through a high-touch sales motion focused on culture-led mid-market buyers. Quote-gating maximises ASP and discourages SMB self-serve, which would dilute the brand position against BambooHR.

What modules sit at which price tier?

Core ~$10 PEPM (directory, time-off, org chart, basic reporting). Performance adds ~$4 PEPM. Compensation Management adds ~$5 PEPM. Surveys / Talent Insights adds ~$3 PEPM. Full suite $18-$25 PEPM.

What is the minimum HiBob will quote?

50 seats is the practical floor. Under that, prospects are routed back through the partner channel or declined.

How do HiBob contracts treat renewal uplift?

Standard 7-12% annual uplift. Cap to 5% is achievable with a 2-3 year commit signed up front.

When is HiBob worth the premium over BambooHR?

When the buyer is a culture-led People team at 150-500 employees and the differentiated value is in the surveys, social feed, and global hub. For US payroll-dominant 75-150 person buyers, BambooHR usually wins on TCO.
